content:
# knr-ops: Logs Bucket + IRSA Role + Flux Kustomization

## File layout

```
infra/s3/logs/
├── kustomization.yaml
├── bucket.yaml
├── bucket-pab.yaml
├── bucket-policy.yaml
infra/iam/logs-irsa/
├── kustomization.yaml
├── role.yaml
├── policy.yaml
├── policy-attachment.yaml
flux/
├── kustomizations.yaml        # appended
overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml   # patched
overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml  # patched
```

## 1. Base manifests — `infra/s3/logs/bucket.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-placeholder   # patched per-env
  versioning:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlock:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

## 2. `infra/s3/logs/bucket-policy.yaml` — least privilege bucket policy

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: BucketPolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  bucketRef:
    name: myapp-logs
  policy: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Sid": "AllowIRSAReadWrite",
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": { "AWS": "${ROLE_ARN}" },
          "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:AbortMultipartUpload", "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts"],
          "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-placeholder", "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-placeholder/*"]
        }
      ]
    }
```

Note: per the task I use ACK CRDs (`s3.services.k8s.aws`). If your repo truly pins `s3.aws.upbound.io` (Crossplane), swap `kind: Bucket` → `kind: Bucket`/`ObjectVersioning`/`ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration`/`PublicAccessBlock` composition with the same fields — the overlay structure is identical.

## 3. `infra/s3/logs/kustomization.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - bucket-policy.yaml
```

## 4. IRSA role — `infra/iam/logs-irsa/role.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-placeholder
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [{
        "Effect": "Allow",
        "Principal": { "Federated": "${OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN}" },
        "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
        "Condition": {
          "StringEquals": {
            "${OIDC_HOST}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:logs-writer",
            "${OIDC_HOST}:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
          }
        }
      }]
    }
```

## 5. `infra/iam/logs-irsa/policy.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
spec:
  name: myapp-logs-rw
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [{
        "Effect": "Allow",
        "Action": [
          "s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:DeleteObject",
          "s3:AbortMultipartUpload", "s3:ListMultipartUploadParts",
          "s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetBucketLocation"
        ],
        "Resource": [
          "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-placeholder",
          "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-placeholder/*"
        ]
      }]
    }
```

## 6. `infra/iam/logs-irsa/policy-attachment.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: PolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-rw-attach
spec:
  policyRef:
    name: myapp-logs-rw
  roleRef:
    name: myapp-logs-irsa
```

## 7. Overlays — `overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml` (append to existing)

```yaml
resources:
  - ../../infra/s3/logs
  - ../../infra/iam/logs-irsa

replacements:
  - source:
      kind: ConfigMap
      name: env-config     # existing per-overlay env config
      fieldPath: data.oidc_provider_arn
    targets:
      - select: { kind: Role, name: myapp-logs-irsa }
        fieldPaths: [spec.assumeRolePolicyDocument]
        options:
          delimiter: null

patches:
  - target: { group: s3.services.k8s.aws, kind: Bucket, name: myapp-logs }
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/name
        value: myapp-logs-dev
  - target: { group: iam.services.k8s.aws, kind: Role, name: myapp-logs-irsa }
    patch: |-
      - op: replace
        path: /spec/name
        value: myapp-logs-irsa-dev
```

**`overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`** is identical except:
- bucket/role names suffixed `-prod`
- prod policy document hard-scoped to `arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod` (no placeholders → no wildcards per acceptance criteria #4)

## 8. SOPS — secrets

The OIDC provider ARN / host per env are not secret, but if you keep IRSA trust metadata in an encrypted config:

```yaml
# overlays/dev/oidc-config.sops.yaml (encrypted via: sops -e --age <key>)
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: oidc-config
type: Opaque
stringData:
  oidc_provider_arn: ENC[AES256_GCM,...]
  oidc_host: ENC[AES256_GCM,...]
```

Flux decrypts via its `.spec.decryption.provider: sops` on the source; the overlay consumes it via the replacement above (read from the decrypted `ConfigMap` produced by a small controller or by keeping non-sensitive ARNs in a plain `ConfigMap` — preferred, since ARNs aren't secrets).

## 9. Flux kustomization — `flux/kustomizations.yaml` (append)

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: infra-s3-logs
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/dev          # prod variant: ./overlays/prod, separate KS
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops               # existing repo source
  wait: true
  timeout: 2m
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
---
# prod instance (independent reconcile, acceptance criteria #7)
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: infra-s3-logs-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./overlays/prod
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  wait: true
  timeout: 2m
  decryption:
    provider: sops
    secretRef:
      name: sops-age
```

## Service account annotation (app side)

```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/myapp-logs-irsa-{env}
```

## Verification checklist

- ✅ Bucket name per-env via overlay patch
- ✅ Versioning `Enabled`
- ✅ SSE AES256
- ✅ Public access block (all four flags)
- ✅ IRSA role scoped to one service account, no wildcards in prod
- ✅ Separate Flux Kustomization reconciling `infra/s3/logs` independently
- ✅ SOPS decryption configured; nothing sensitive in plaintext
- ✅ Dev/prod independently deployable — separate Flux KS instances targeting separate overlay paths
